chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Zeisu kiangah, mihonpite in neh uh a, Pasian thu a ngaih lai takun Gennesaret tuili geiah amah a ding hi.
Tua lai takin tuipi gei a, khawl gunkuang nih om a mu hi. Ngasa bengte in gunkuang sung panin paikhia uh a, ngente a sawp uh hi.
Simon’ gunkuang ahi tua gunkuangte khat tungah Zeisu a tuan’ khit ciangin, gunkuang tuipi gei pan tomno a kihal nadingin Simon kiangah a gen hi. Zeisu in gunkuang tungah tu-a mihonpite thu a hilh hi.
A thuhilh a tawp khit ciangin, “Tui thukna-ah khin in la, ngasa khuh na’ng ngen paai in,” ci-in Simon thu a pia hi.
Simon in zong, “Topa aw, kote in zankhua-in ka hahkat uh hangin, khat beek ka man kei uh hi. Ahih hangin thu nong piak bangin ngen ka paai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua banga a paih khit ciangin, ngasa tam mahmah khuh kha a, ngen a kikeek hi.
Adang gunkuang khatah a om a lawmte zong hong pai-in, hong huh nadingin amaute khut van a, amaute hong pai-in gunkuang nih ngasa tawh kidim-in a tum dek tak hi.
Simon Piter in a muh ciangin Zeisu khuk kiangah bokin, “Topa aw, mawhnei mi ka hih ciangin ka kiang pan paikhia in,” a ci hi.
Bang hangin hih bangin gen hiam i cih leh, amah tawh a omkhawm mi khempeuhte in a khuhsa ngasate lamdang a sa uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Simon’ lawmte Zebedi’ tapa Jakob leh Johante in zong lamdang a sa uh hi. Zeisu in Simon kiangah, “Lau kei in. Tu-a kipan nang in mite na man ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in tuipi geiah gunkuang a khawlsak khit uh ciangin, amaute neihsa khempeuh nusia-in Zeisu’ nung a zui uh hi.
Khua khatah Zeisu a om lai takin, a pumtang a phak mi khat a om hi. Tua pa in Zeisu a muh ciangin bok a, “Topa aw, nong hih nop leh, kei nong damsak zo ding hi,” ci-in a thuum hi.
Zeisu in a khut zanin lawng a, “Ka hih nuam hi, na dam ta in,” a cih leh, thakhatin a dam pah hi.
Zeisu in hih thu kuama kiangah a gen loh nadingin thu a pia hi. “Pasian’ siampi kiangah pai in la, va kilak in. Amau in a theih nadingun Moses’ thu piaksa bangin biakna na pia in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu thu kizeel semsem a, mihonpite in thu ngai ding ahi zongin, cinate in damna ngah ding ahi zongin a kikhawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah gampa lakah pai a, thu a ngen hi.

Ni khat Zeisu in thu a hilh lai takin, Jerusalem khuapi pan a kipan Galile gam leh Judah gam khua khempeuh pan hong pai Farisaite leh Pasian’ Thukham siate in a kiangah a tu uh hi. Cinatna a damsak thei dingin Topa’ vangliatna Zeisu tungah a tung hi.
Tua lai takin mite in khut leh khe si mi khat a lupna tawh a puak uh ciangin inn sungah paipih a, Zeisu mai-ah koih nading a zong uh hi.
Mihonpi kikhawm ahih manin, lut nading lam a muh zawh loh uh ciangin, innkhum tungah kahto uh a, innkhum a vuhlet khit uh ciangin, lupna tawh cinapa Zeisu mai-ah mite lai zangah a khiasuk uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute’ upna a theih ciangin, “Lawm aw, na mawhnate kimaisak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Laitheite leh Farisaite in, “Pasian tungah a pau a khial hih mi kua mi ahi hiam? Pasian longal kua in mawhna maisak zo hiam?” ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute ngaihsutna a theih ciangin, “Note in bang hangin na lungsim sung uh ah tua bangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Bang ci leng a baih zaw hiam? ‘Na mawhnate kimaisak zo hi,’ ci leng a baih zaw hiam? ‘Tho in la pai in,’ ci leng a baih zaw hiam?
Ahih hangin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawhna a maisak theih nading thu a neih lam na theih nadingun, ‘Tho in, na lupna pua in la, na innah ciah in,’” ci-in khut leh khe sipa kiangah a ci hi.
Amah in amaute mai-ah thakhatin tho a, a lupna pua-in Pasian’ min phatin a ciah hi.
Tuate khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh a, Pasian a phat uh hi. “Eite in tuni-in nalamdang a tuam i mu zo hi,” ci-in a lau uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin Zeisu paikhia a, Levi kici siahdon’na bukah tu-in a om a mu hi. “Ka nung hong zui in,” a cih ciangin,
ding-in, a neihsa khempeuh nusia-in a nung a zui hi.
Levi in ama innah lawmvakna pawi a bawl hi. Siahdongte leh midang tampite in amaute tawh an ne-in a tu khawm uh hi.
Farisaite leh laitheite in, “Note in siahdongte leh mawhneite tawh, bang hangin an nekhawm tui dawnkhawm na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a nungzuite a ko uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Cidamte in zato deih lo uh hi. Cinate bek in a deih uh hi.
Miphate sam dingin hong pai ka hi kei hi. Mawhneite sam dingin hong pai ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Johan’ nungzuite in an nek tang zeelin, thu a ngen uh hi. Farisaite’ nungzuite in zong tua bangin ahih uh hi. Ahih hangin na nungzuite in an ne-in tui a dawn uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in zong, “Zipipa in a lawmte tawh a omkhawm lai takin tuate in an a tang sak zo ding uh hiam?
Ahih hangin a hun hong tung ding a, zipipa in a lawmte tawh a kikhen khit ciangin, tua ni-in amaute in an nek a tang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua lai takin Zeisu in thugentehna thu a hilh-inah, “Kuamah in puan thak bek khat eukhia a, puan lui a thuap ngei kei uh hi. Tua bang a thuap leh, a puan thak keek a, puan thak bek in puan lui tawh a kilem kei ding hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahtui thak a thun ngei kei hi. Tua bangin a thun leh, leenggah tui in savun tamsak ding a, leenggahtui luangkhia-in, savun zong a kisia gawp ding hi.
Leenggahtui thak savun um thak sungah a kithun ding hi.
Kuamah in leenggahtui lui a dawn khit ciangin, leenggahtui thak a duh kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Leenggahtui lui a pha hi, a ci hi,” ci-in Zeisu in a gen hi.
